messages:
DeployBot: Rollout INITIATED for prod - tag=release-2026.03.19-rc4 commit=7f9d3a env=prod regions=[us,eu,apac] strategy=staggered(canary->regional) change_window=2026-03-19T22:00-02:00Z. Notes: model-serving optimizations + quant kernel update. Changelog: https://ci.internal/release/2026-03-19

claire.r: Quick Q — can we hold APAC until the config sync to SG completes? last sync showed feature-flag drift for db-migrations.

josh_oncall: Roger, watching alerts. I'll keep an eye on p99/p95 and error-rate during EU canary. Pinged oncall mob if anything spikes. :eyes:

DeployBot: Canary complete in us — status=healthy; p95 latency +1ms, error-rate steady. Proceeding to eu in 2m. rollout_step=eu_canary

carl_eng: EU canary starting now. Rolling to 3 canary nodes (zone eu-west-1a/1b). Tag pinned locally to release-2026.03.19-rc4 for the rollout.

DeployBot: EU canary FAILED health checks: error-rate spike >1.2% on model-serving pool eu-rt; increased 5xxs from upstream. Automatic scaling attempted (+2 nodes) but errors persisted. Pausing further rollout and blocking apac. Suggested action: rollback/pin. :warning:
\npriya_sre: Investigating — stacktrace points to quantization kernel mismatch on specific CPU kernels (intel-avx512) after rc4. I can repro on 2 nodes with same config. @carl_eng can we pin EU back to previous release (release-2026.03.15) while we debug rc4?

marta_pm: Any customer-facing impact yet or just internal infra? Need to surface in status page if user-facing.

amanda_support: We're seeing a couple of EU-region 503 reports from internal apps and 2 external tickets since 22:18 UTC — marking P2.

carl_eng: Will pin EU now. Running command: ```./deploy --region eu --action pin --tag release-2026.03.15 --reason "rc4 health failures" --force``` ETA ~3m. I'll post progress.

DeployBot: Pin operation initiated for eu -> release-2026.03.15. ops_id=op-987654. Expected completion 180s.

DeployBot: Pin completed: eu now serving release-2026.03.15. EU health checks re-run: passing. 5xxs dropped to baseline. Rolling forward to apac is blocked per request from @claire.r.

claire.r: Confirm hold on apac until config sync completes (db feature-flag propagation). ETA ~12m. Please do not proceed to apac until I mark ready.

josh_oncall: Acknowledged. Will give explicit thumbs-up after validating metrics post-pin.

DeployBot: us done (release-2026.03.19-rc4), eu pinned to release-2026.03.15, apac scheduled after hold. Closing loop here, will post another update when apac starts/finishes.

marta_pm: Please add a short note to the release notes and postmortem: EU rolled back/pinned to previous release due to quant kernel regression in rc4; APAC held for config sync. I'll draft the blurb.

carl_eng: Filed a short incident note in the deploy ticket and opened a TODO to revert the kernel change until we have wider validation.

amanda_support: Thanks — I'll update the support tickets to say we rolled EU back and are holding APAC.

josh_oncall: Final check: metrics stable for 6m post-pin. thumbs up from me to proceed when @claire.r clears.
